verdict.rationale: Token2 is not itself an agent. It is a security-key vendor with management tools, including an official CLI (fido2-manage), so an official MCP server is a plausible ecosystem offering and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The existing CLI and Graph API tooling are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
